newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS - Australia MP Langmore resigns from parliament.
newsitem.headline: RTRS - Australia MP Langmore resigns from parliament.

text.p: Australian member of parliament John Langmore resigned from his Australian Capital Territory seat of Fraser on Tuesday, a spokesman told a Labor party room briefing.
"John has accepted a position with the United Nations as the director of the division of social development," the spokesman said.
Langmore, 57, will take up the position as Australia's senior representative at the United Nations headquarters in New York.
He played an active role at the U.N. social development conference in Copenhagen last year and has co-authored articles with U.N. development programme officer Inge Kaul.
Langmore, a persistent campaigner for interventionist economic policy, has been Labor member for Fraser since 1984.
He was senior private secretary to the employment and industrial relations minister from 1983 to 1984 and was economic advisor to then treasurer Paul Keating in 1983.
His previous posts include assistant director of the national planning office of Papua New Guinea from 1969 to 1973.
